resources.name: instructions
resources.title: Usage guidelines for Idescat MCP
resources.description: Server usage guide (statistic selection, data retrieval flow, JSON-stat interpretation, accuracy, and source attribution). Same content as the 'instructions' header in the handshake.

resources.name: geo-glossary
resources.title: Territorial codes glossary (geo)
resources.description: Territorial division codes used by the 'geo' parameter (cat, prov, at, com, mun, dis, sec) with their description.

resources.name: stats-catalog
resources.title: Idescat statistics catalog
resources.description: Complete list of statistics (id, name, description, datasets, geo, url). Equivalent to the get_idescat_stats tool but attachable as context.

templates.name: statistic
templates.title: Statistic information
templates.description: Statistic metadata by acronym (e.g., idescat://stat/censph): name, description, datasets, geo, url, and last update.

templates.name: statistic-tables
templates.title: Statistic tables
templates.description: List of tables for a statistic by acronym (e.g., idescat://stat/censph/tables): identifier and name of each table.

templates.name: table-metadata
templates.title: Table metadata
templates.description: JSON-stat metadata of a table (e.g., idescat://table/censph/538): dimensions, categories, units, and related territorial divisions.

templates.name: table-data
templates.title: Table data (JSON-stat)
templates.description: Complete table data in JSON-stat format for Catalonia as a whole (e.g., idescat://table/censph/538/data). Returns an error if the table exceeds 20,000 cells; in this case, use the get_table_data tool with filters (filters, last).
